name: Himawari-9 Band 13 (10.4 µm Thermal IR) Cloud Tiles
citation: Japan Meteorological Agency / NOAA. Himawari-9 AHI Level-1b Full Disk. NOAA Big Data Program. https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-himawari/
description: 30-min cloud cover tiles derived from Himawari-9 AHI Band 13 (thermal IR). Covers Nepal + surrounding HKH region at zoom levels 5–8. Stored as PNG tiles in Vercel Blob.
spatial_res: 2 km (GEOS native) → resampled to XYZ tiles
note: This dataset drives the live cloud overlay on the map. It does not write to Postgres.
